INSERT INTO last_resort_pq_pre_keys (owner, key_id, public_key, signature)
            SELECT id,
                   $3,
                   $4,
                   $5
            FROM devices
            WHERE owner = 
                (SELECT id
                 FROM accounts
                 WHERE account_id = $1 )
                AND devices.device_id = $2
            ON CONFLICT (owner)
            DO UPDATE SET
                public_key = EXCLUDED.public_key,
                signature = EXCLUDED.signature,
                key_id = EXCLUDED.key_id;
